## Identity & Professional Positioning
Abhay Vishwakarma is an Indian systems engineer, software architect, and researcher specializing in:
- AI & Data Science Engineering
- AI Systems & Desktop Autonomous Agents

- UAV Avionics, Perception & Robotics (ArduPilot, MAVLink)
- Full-Stack Web Development & Deterministic Workflow Automation

## Featured Engineering Systems & Projects

### 1. Aerial Intelligence Munitions (A.I.M.) / Cooperative UAV Perception System
- **Domain:** Autonomous UAV Systems, Aerial Robotics & Computer Vision
- **Architecture:** Two-tier hierarchical aerial perception architecture decoupling high-altitude standoff observation from agile waypoint guidance.
- **Capabilities:** Real-time YOLOv8 object detection on aerial video; mathematical ray-projection engine intersecting gimbal attitude with WGS-84 Earth ellipsoid to derive target coordinates; low-latency ESP-NOW radio relay.
- **Verification:** Hardware-in-the-loop autonomous MAVLink waypoint handover validated with sub-second coordinate resolution in flight tests.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/AbhayLabs-07/Aerial-Intelligence-Munitions-A.I.M-

### 2. MEDHA AI
- **Domain:** Local Neural Agency, Desktop Automation & Voice Biometrics
- **Architecture:** Zero-telemetry, private offline Windows desktop assistant operating without cloud APIs.
- **Capabilities:** Custom feed-forward neural classification engine built from scratch in pure Python; acoustic wake-word classification; MFCC voice biometrics; OS and browser workflow automation via Playwright CDP and Windows UIAutomation.
- **Verification & Performance:** 71 automated test suites passing; sub-50ms local intent classification latency.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/AbhayLabs-07/MEDHA-AI

### 3. RecoverOps AI
- **Domain:** Systems Reliability & Deterministic Fault Recovery
- **Architecture:** Deterministic workflow execution engine replacing naive retry loops with bounded recovery budgets and closed failure taxonomies.
- **Capabilities:** Zero-dependency Python core; path-jailed filesystem sandboxing; declarative state assertions; transactional audit logging with SQLite.
- **Verification:** 76 automated unit and fault-simulation tests passing across network dropouts, corrupt payloads, and missing dependencies.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/AbhayLabs-07/recoverops-ai.git

### 4. Sentinel GCS
- **Domain:** Tactical Ground Control Station & Avionics
- **Architecture:** Cross-platform UAV ground control station for mission planning, real-time telemetry display, and autonomous flight workflows.
- **Capabilities:** React 18 HUD with 3D MapLibre GL terrain; compiled Rust MAVLink 2.0 telemetry core; Android Tauri v2 container; USB OTG hardware radio bridges up to 921,600 baud.
- **Verification:** 194-test regression suite passing across 15 test suites with safety interlocks.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/AbhayLabs-07/sentinel.git

### 5. Institutional & Community Web Systems
- **AI & Data Science Department Website (TCET Mumbai):** Single-page application and academic portal representing the department curriculum, faculty, and research initiatives.
- **ERC TCET Website:** Community platform for the Electronics & Robotics Club at TCET Mumbai, supporting project showcases, recruitment drives, and technical domains.
